author: Patrikano
body:
Hi,

So I was playing kb wars on scrim, and something weird happened, _vouch started dealing 2 hits of damage to me every hit.

anyways in video title is 'hacking - vouch_' 
I accidently put '_' after name, it's actually '_Vouch'

Anyways tell me if this is normal, cause it doesn't seem normal at all...
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IW4CZf3VxE

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey Patrikano,

As far as I am aware, this is a glitch that sometimes occurs on the kb wars map. If you ever see it happen again, just ask the player to relog and if they continue to play with this glitch report it to a staff member, because it could be considered as abusing glitches. 

Thanks for the report, we're still trying to sort out this problem.

-Spookz
